stem:
Your President may easily become king. Your Senate is so imperfectly constructed that your dearest rights may be sacrificed by what may be a small minority. . . . Your strongholds will be in the hands of your enemies. . . .

—Patrick Henry, speech at the Virginia Ratifying Convention, 1788

Patrick Henry was criticizing which aspect of the Constitution in this excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: The eligibility requirements for congressional office

options.label: B
options.text: The power granted to the central government

options.label: C
options.text: The establishment of a separate judicial branch

options.label: D
options.text: The difficulty of the amendment process
